name: La India Bonita
notes: All 4 photos are TV-displayed menu boards. Photos 1 & 2 show the same board (wide shot + straight-on close shot) covering Specials/Breakfast/Quesadillas/Enchiladas/Tostadas/Drinks/Combinations/A La Carte/Burritos/Specialties; merged, using photo 1 (least glare). Photos 3 & 4 show a second board with some overlapping categories (Burritos, Enchiladas, Quesadillas, Breakfast, Tostadas, Combinations/A La Carte, Specialties, Extras) priced differently from board 1 -- to avoid duplicate items with conflicting prices, only board 3/4's non-overlapping categories (Tacos, Tortas, Sides, Extras, and the combo-style Specials list) were added. Quesadillas 'Birria' line had no clearly attached price due to glare and was kept with no price.
